run_ddar_solver: run the DD+AR symbolic solver on a geometry problem graph and write the solution
run_alphageometry_search: run the AlphaGeometry beam search proof solver with a language model on a geometry problem
write_proof_solution: write a geometry proof solution with proof steps and auxiliary constructions to an output file
translate_constrained_to_constructive: translate a constraint-based geometry predicate like perp or coll into a constructive predicate
validate_auxiliary_construction: validate and translate an auxiliary construction string against the current proof state graph
